api_provenance.scope: Property existence/read-only status and enum membership only. Does not simulate native Studio behavior.

checks: Actual builder execution for every catalog trail
120 moving frames and 35 stationary frames per trail
All preview models created and destroyed
Every Model, Part and WedgePart write names an existing writable API property
Material and PartType enum names verified against Roblox API metadata
limits: Roblox-compatible math/Instance test doubles; native rendering, networking, replication and physics were not executed.
Property write count is repeated runtime coverage, not that many distinct behavior tests.
